cards.answer: Cassiopeia is an AP mage who poisons enemies and repeatedly uses Twin Fang for increased damage and healing against poisoned targets. Her poison clouds slow and block movement abilities, while her ultimate stuns enemies facing her.
cards.counterplay: Avoid her poison zones, limit extended trades while poisoned, and turn away when she casts her ultimate.

cards.answer: Noxious Blast explodes in a targeted area after a brief delay, poisoning enemies for magic damage over time. Hitting an enemy champion grants Cassiopeia movement speed that decays.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the targeted area and respect her chase potential after a champion hit.

cards.answer: Miasma leaves lingering poison clouds that deal magic damage, slow enemies, and ground them while inside. Grounded enemies cannot use movement abilities.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the clouds and walk out before attempting movement abilities.

cards.answer: Twin Fang is a repeatable targeted magic damage spell. Against poisoned targets, it deals increased damage and heals Cassiopeia; killing the target refunds its mana cost.
cards.counterplay: Limit extended trades while poisoned and create distance to reduce repeated Twin Fang pressure.

cards.counterplay: Turn away as she casts and move out of the cone.
